Specification: This module defines mathematical notions related to derivatives and uses them to specify a higher-order operator for solving ordinary differential equations from initial values. It introduces local definitions for positive reals, open intervals, neighborhoods, first derivatives, and higher derivatives, then defines Integrate(D, a, b, InitVals) by choosing a witness function g satisfying derivative and initial-value constraints over an open interval around the integration endpoints. The file is a pure mathematical specification with no state variables, no transition system, no fairness assumptions, and no temporal verification properties.
IfThenElse: IF k = 0 THEN g = f ELSE \E gg \in [DOMAIN f -> Real] : /\ IsFirstDeriv(g, gg) /\ IsD[k-1, gg]
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE g : \E e \in PosReal : /\ g \in [0..n -> [OpenInterval(a-e, b+e) -> Real]] /\ \A i \in 1..n : /\ IsDeriv(i, g[i], g[0]) /\ g[i-1][a] = InitVals[i] /\ \A r \in OpenInterval(a-e, b+e) : D[ <<r>> \o [i \in 1..(n+1) |-> g[i-1][r]] ] = 0
